single.rationale: Red Cat shows explosive revenue growth (128% YoY to $40.7M) from Army drone program wins, but massive operating losses (-$66.6M), deteriorating gross margins (3.1%), and extreme valuation (34.65x EV/revenue) present substantial risk. Recent equity raises ($249M in 2025) provide runway, but the path to profitability remains unclear amid rising R&D costs (44% of revenue) and production inefficiencies. Government spending uncertainty and execution risks warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.
